title: Where would you like to use EasyPaper?
preserved: Your existing local library stays on this computer. Remote mode uses the server's library; turning it off returns to your local data.
urlHelp: Enter the address you use to open EasyPaper in your browser. Sign in with your server account after connecting.
failed: Could not connect. Check the server address and try again.
download: Download server data to this computer
downloadHelp: Copies your server documents, originals, translations, notes and reading data into your local library. Local documents and settings are preserved. Each download adds a new copy; this is not automatic synchronization.
confirmDownload: Download your server library as new local copies? Repeating this action creates additional copies. Keep EasyPaper open until it finishes.
downloading: Downloading server backup: {{size}} MiB… Keep EasyPaper open.
importing: Adding documents to the local library… Keep EasyPaper open.
completed: Added {{count}} documents to your local library. Turn off the remote connection to use them locally.
connectionError: Could not load connection settings. Retry before opening your library.
localSettings: Manage local / remote mode and download server data.
